entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling because I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number? And just so I understand, is there a technical fault with the shoes, or is it more of a preference issue?

The name is Sam Jones, order number is VF88602. It's not a defect, but the fit is all wrong. No matter how I adjust the cleats, they keep giving me terrible blisters after any ride longer than an hour.

I'm sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Thank you for that information. Let me pull up your order... VF88602... Okay, I see it here. The delivery date was 66 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I really tried to make them work.

I understand. Let me just check our policy. Okay, good news. For our standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're at day 66, you are well within that period. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you.

That's great, I appreciate that. Since I did have to deal with the discomfort and now the hassle of sending them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 10% for the trouble?

I understand your position, but unfortunately, I'm not able to offer an additional discount. The good news is we can process the full refund for the shoes as soon as we receive them. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Alright, I suppose that's fair. A full refund is what I was hoping for. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome, Sam. Once the item is scanned at the drop-off location, your refund will be initiated. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Isaac.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
